packageRules.description: The Go toolchain is pinned in mise.toml (what CI and the machines run), go.mod (go directive) and the Dockerfile build stage. Move them in one PR so CI and the image never build with different compilers.
Bun is pinned in mise.toml (what CI and the machines run), web/ and integrations/rigel-sync/ package.json packageManager, and the Dockerfiles. Same reasoning as the Go toolchain.
golang.org/x/* release together and usually need to move together.
Routine frontend minor/patch bumps in one PR.
Keep the .gitea and .github copies of the same action on the same version.
engines is the oldest Node the sync runner accepts, not a dependency to pin: rangeStrategy pin made it exactly v26.11.1 (#94) while the runner image ran Node 22.

The Node runtime is mise.toml (CI's Node, through jdx/mise-action) and the runner image (integrations/rigel-sync/Dockerfile). Move them in one PR so CI tests the Node that ships; renovate offers only LTS majors here.
@types/node must describe the runtime's major, not the newest Node: #98 moved it to 26 under a Node 22 image. Its major moves by hand together with the node runtime group.
